text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: shipping a 50k-user pilot for Fleetly. They want a single-page, customer-facing preflight: cache priming guidance, recommended batch targets, streaming fallback language for UX, and a tiny renewal-signal form. Can eng+SRE draft safe, copy-paste defaults and a short checklist?

kevin_sales: Need the one-pager to double as a checklist the customer PM can sign off on. Include a single "go/no-go" line for renewals (pass/fail) and a short field to capture "reason" so CS can triage renewal risk.

alex_eng: Drafting safe defaults: warm pool: 2 GPUs / 3 workers; prefill: 12 distinct prefixes that mirror top intents; batch caps: 12 for 8k models, 6 for 32k; prefer latency-driven batching (cap batch size when p95 > target).

tyler_sre: Operational notes: KV cache TTLs: keep sentinel keys for 24h and rotate prefixes daily to avoid staleness. Prefill cadence suggestion for low-traffic tenants: run 6 warm calls every 30m during business hours (cron: "*/30 9-17 * * MON-FRI"). Limit daily warm tokens to ~1k/tenant. Circuit-breaker: if p95 latency breaches 500ms for 10m OR error-rate > 2% for 10m -> trigger fallback.

alex_eng: Copy-paste sandbox warmup (customer-facing):
```
# 8 parallel warmup requests
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"rwd-8k-stable","input":"Warmup intent '$i' for Fleetly"}' &
done
wait
```

maria_cs: Include a short streaming fallback blurb for PMs that they can show end-users: "If latency increases we will stream partial results immediately and show a status banner explaining the delay; exact partial text may be refined when the full response completes." Keep wording simple and customer-friendly.

natalie_cs: Renewal-signal mini-form (copy-paste JSON they can email back):
```
{
  "contact":"<name>",
  "satisfaction": "4",
  "golden_hit_rate": "85%",
  "hallucinations": "none observed",
  "go_no_go": "pass",
  "notes": "prefill cadence requested"
}
```

tyler_sre: Provide an ops toggle (admin only) to force fallback while we investigate:
```
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/fleetly/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -d '{"fallback_model":"rwd-2k-quant","reason":"investigate-latency"}'
```

oncall-bot: Note: control-plane changes must be scheduled >=24h before production deploy window (Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC).

maria_cs: Perfect. Can Alex + Tyler drop the final one-page PDF and these snippets in #cs-assets by EOD? I'll attach the sample prompts and the renewal JSON and send to Fleetly PM tomorrow morning.

alex_eng: Will upload PDF + snippets.

tyler_sre: I'll include the cron and circuit-breaker lines in the runbook blurb.

maria_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup:
